name: T-MINUS
tagline: A plant turnaround planned backwards from the day the plant stops.
problem: Every few years a plant stops on purpose for about two weeks. Most of those stops miss their window or their budget, because scope, cost, crews and readiness are planned in separate places. T-MINUS puts them on one countdown.
how: Match messy source records into one clean asset list.
Decide scope: mandatory, include, defer or review, each with a reason.
Price four ways to run the outage on one number.
Place the chosen scope against the crews that exist, hour by hour.
Track readiness per discipline and open six stage gates as evidence arrives.
features: Six-facility portfolio and a twelve-turnaround calendar
Data integration with duplicate and exception marking
148 work requests sorted into mandatory, include, defer and review
Outage economics for four ways to run the outage
Hour-by-hour schedule check against available crews
Readiness meters and six stage gates
